text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, haven't stepped on the scale in a while...
I've gained quite a bit of weight.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's a major crisis!
I know some great diet-friendly snacks.
And some exercises too~...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't worry about it.
I appreciate the thought, though."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I-Is she going to be okay?
What if this affects the race...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(All those extra carbs first thing in the morning...
Ah, or maybe they wanted to gain weight?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Huh, so she's not eating today.
Does that mean she doesn't actually want to gain weight...?)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh, this is good.
The meat and cheese go together way too well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, looks delish... Wait, no!
Not another high-calorie thing~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, Stego-san,
how do you manage your weight control...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nothing in particular.
It'll go back to normal on its own.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
âHere.
Ah, you look a bit slimmer than before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaaaat!?
What is that?
I'm so jealous...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Stay Gold is always like this.
Even if she gains weight temporarily,
simply going about her day brings it right back to normal!
